experiment: zero-model census of model-visible spreadsheet observation work
tokenizer_policy: closest-known GLM-family tokenizer; counts ESTIMATED; byte/char counts exact

rules.redundancy_basis: model-visible prior history only, same trajectory, same workbook generation
rules.generation: bumped on save/write or LibreOffice/recalc action; cross-generation facts never match
rules.no_hindsight: mechanical classes use prior history + current observation + generation only
rules.derivation: conservative: aggregation-shaped output + aggregation op in action + fully-visible inputs
rules.reinspection: mechanical repeat with gap>=3 obs (or verify-intent + gap>=2) since last same-query/same-facts
